notes.title: Slightly improved the onboarding experince
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The information within the tutorial as been slightly spaced out and trimmed in just a couple small spots to make it more digestible. 
[*] Accessing the robot equipping and crafting menus are now locked until the player completes 1 and 2 matches respectively (win or lose). This is to lessen the amount of information overload and for a better pacing.  
[/list]

As always, for those interested in buying the game, I suggest play the demo first to get a feel. 
This guide is here to help you too! https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3465247098

Many thanks!
Developer Dob - Rob.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes #3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Round breaktime will end early when both teams run out of repair energy
[*] Reboot success rates slightly lowered for both player and NPC
[*] Fixed a couple minor UI issues, such as mirrored text or incorrect bindings showing.
[*] The very first instance of a 'voting event' is now delayed by several days to reduce the amount of information overload for new players (only applicable to new games)
[/list]

As always, I recommend playing the demo before buying the game to see if you like the unconventional gameplay. If you run into difficulties and want a few tips, I recommend the guide in the community section. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3465247098

A big thanks to those that have supported the game, to those that wrote a steam review and/or those that came by my booth at PAX East!

notes.title: Minor bug fixes #2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed gorilla arm ability from persisting outside of battle
[*] Robots were sometimes standing out of position during the corner repair break time, extra logic added to help prevent this
[*] Some punch card ability combos weren't displaying in the card equip menu. This has been fixed.
[*] Fixed missing UI text in a couple areas of the game
[*] Mine spawner ability will now properly end when a round ends
[/list]

As always, I recommend playing the demo before buying the game to see if you like the unconventional gameplay. 
If you run into any issues or want a few tips, I recommend the guide in the community section. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3465247098

A big thanks to those that have supported the game and the people that dropped a steam review!

notes.title: Post release bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed edge case with the Barrel Body 10% repair energy restore perk, that cause the restoration to not always apply or apply late.
[*] When the CPU used the Barrel Body, the 10% repair energy perk was improperly applying towards the player. This has been fixed
[*] Fixed a visual UI issue with the repair energy meter that was improperly showing 100% full energy prior to use.
[*] Turned off UI navigation for the module wheel. It was causing confusing UI navigation for controller players. Activating the module wheel should be initiating by the shortcut button or mouse input. 
[*] Parts crafting minigame will slow the flashing rate if the player fails several inputs attempts
[*] Added a fallback texture for missing/white UI in the battle panel.
[*] Fixed controller UI navigation when using combo abilities
[/list]

A big thanks to those that have supported the game and the people that dropped a steam review! It's a big help to us indies!

notes.title: 2 Player mode! & Latency test branch.
notes.content:
[h3][b]After several long days of mental gymnastics I figured out how to support a local 2 player VS mode![/b] [/h3]
[list]
[*] The versus mode is accessible from the battle menu.
[*] Player 2 won't have access to mouse inputs, meaning they will need to play on a controller. The controller must be assigned to player 2 in the settings > controls menu.
[*] Robot parts, abilities and which arena the battle takes place are reflective of your career progress when playing a versus match. (not applicable in the demo)
[*]Versus mode has a handicap value that will modify the damage output of your regular punches. It's intended to accommodate players of differing skill levels.
[/list]
If you encounter any Versus bugs please let me know. 

[h3][b]Latency test branch[/b][/h3]
For any players experiencing constant input fails whist tapping with the music (in battle), I have a special demo for you with a different underlying event system. If can be accessed by right clicking the demo in Steam, go to Properties>Beta> and change Participation from None to the "testing" branch. I'd be curious to hear if this fixes the constant fails for you.

[h3][b]Other updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Moved the dash buttons on controllers to the trigger buttons for easier access.
[*] A warning text will pop up when the laser push ability is ineffective on a fighter that passively cannot be pushed.  
[*] Improved the UI navigation between the combat mode buttons and lesser used arm/stop buttons.
[*] Last and somewhat least, redesigned my company logo to a sleeping astronaut. I wanted to keep the space theme but make it more simplified as logos should be.
[/list]

Thanks!
Developer Dob (Rob)

notes.title: Cosmetics and more!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Thanks to some community suggestions the game has been updated gloves cosmetics, accessible from the parts equipping menu. As the name implies, cosmetics are just a visual flair you can equip on your gloves. They can be purchased with your in-game credits.  
[*]Tightened up the static overload tapping minigame. There was a slight offset between the visuals and music beat. 
[*]Barrel body now regenerates repair energy per round
[*]Barrel head slightly improved processor power
[*]Lowered HP of all head parts by a bit to slightly increase odds of a headless knockout.
[*]Improved the UI selection pathing in regards to selecting abilities and punchcards for controllers/keyboard naviation. If you tapped right too many times whist loading punchcards, it would navigate down to the bottom menu buttons which was annoying... this has been fixed.
[/list]

*Edit*
[*] Better syncing of the visual tapping hand when releasing landmines.
[*] Added fallback logic in the language selection screen to help prevent getting stuck (speculative fix)


Thanks for playing! Feedback welcomed.
Developer Dob (Rob)

notes.title: Memory and physics optimizations
notes.content:
[list]
[*]optimized/reduced the required memory allocation, lowering overhead cpu costs.
[*]lowered the amount of interpolation calculations on the arms at the cost physics accuracy. This MAY result in some odd arm movements... but from my tests the arms seem to be performing correctly. (I may add a settings slider for this depending on the results)
[*] Fixed a couple minor bugs
[/list]

*Update* Even more optimizations
[list]
[*]cleared out some memory spikes relating to UI vfx. Some UI elements have been swapped out for some simplified lightweight visuals.
[*]less GPU load 
[/list]

More polish to come. Thanks for playing!
Developer Dob (Rob)

notes.title: More optimizations and balance
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improved overall performance, particularly on the mid-lowest range setting.
[*]Shadows cost less to compute and also look sharper
[*]Landmines deal more damage to opponents
[*]Incremental HP recovery (a perk on one of the locked robot parts) slightly nerfed
[*]Fixed one mis-timed tap in the parts crafting minigame.
[/list]

*UPDATE*  I moved a couple key bindings around. I moved the dash left/right keys to Q and R for easier access alongside the Arms/Legs/Heat bindings (1,2,3 keys) 

More polish to come. Thanks for playing!
Developer Dob (Rob)

notes.title: Large patch, several adjustments.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]I believe this patch will fix the incorrectly failing beats some players experienced. Part of this fix involved reworking the music events, along with lesser compression on the music. [b]If this resolved the issue or you're still experiencing tons of failed beats, do please let me know![/b]
[*]A few performance optimizations on both the visuals and physics
[*]Some slight polish added to the scrapyard arena. There's now a few arena TVs for visual aid with tapping, they also display a Stop Sign when a break in the music beats are underway.
[*]There were reports of people wanting more ways to restore their repair energy, I added an extra daily event that does just that. I'll be looking for more unique ways to restore repair energy beyond simply buying it. The intent is that repair energy needs to be rationed throughout the bracket matches, which I need to do a better job of informing and balancing. 
[*]Improved the color layout of the starting robot parts
[/list]

More polish to come. Thanks for playing!
Developer Dob (Rob)

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
A few development features I have in the works... 
[list]
[*]Carefully refining the delicate balance between rhythm mechanics and controls. Aiming for a fun chaotic experience while the player juggles robot inputs and rhythmic beats.
[*]Reworking the UI. Aiming to make it easier to read at a glance while supporting new features added

Once I lock down the primary gameplay flow I'll be turning my attention back to the combat abilities (stunning punches, heat generating flamethowers, lazer eyes, etc...)  I welcome any suggested ability ideas!
